hooks.name: Daily Research Standup
hooks.description: Check tasks and plan the day

action.message: Read TASKS.md and tell me: 1) Which tasks are marked 'In Progress'? 2) Which tasks can I start today based on dependencies? 3) Are there any blocked tasks? Do NOT invent task status - only report what's in the file.

I need to document an experiment. Ask me these questions one by one: 1) What did you test? (BM25 baseline / Dense baseline / Query enhancement) 2) What were the exact metric values? (Recall@10, NDCG@10, MRR) 3) What dataset subset did you use? 4) What did you learn? Then create a file in experiments/ following the template in experiment-documentation.md steering. Do NOT invent any metric values.

hooks.name: Summarize Paper
hooks.description: Add a paper to literature review

action.message: I want to add a paper to our literature review. I'll give you the paper details. Create a summary in papers/[YEAR]_[Title].md following the exact template in paper-analysis.md steering. Only include information I provide or that you can verify from the paper - do NOT invent details about the paper's methodology or results.

hooks.name: Sync Decision Status
hooks.description: Update docs after a meeting or discussion

action.message: I had a meeting or discussion and need to update our docs. I'll tell you what was decided. Based ONLY on what I tell you, suggest updates to: 1) TASKS.md if task status changed, 2) RESEARCH_CONTEXT_KERNEL.md.md if decisions changed, 3) research_decisions/open_questions.md if questions were resolved. Do NOT assume any decisions I don't explicitly state.

Help me prepare for a supervisor meeting. Read TASKS.md and RESEARCH_CONTEXT_KERNEL.md.md, then generate: 1) Tasks completed since last update (only those marked Done), 2) Current blockers (from open_questions.md), 3) Questions we need supervisor input on. Base everything on the actual file contents - do NOT invent progress.
